outputs: open-ended text answers to visual questions

changes_made.explanation: Removed models that were only referenced as baselines (GPT-3, OPT-175B) or mentioned in related work but not used in the paper's method (Bart). MCAN is a shot selection strategy, not a model used for generation. Added OSCAR+ which was used for caption generation.
Normalized 'accuracy' to 'Accuracy' and consolidated duplicate entries
No LLMs were used as judges/evaluators in this paper. LLMs (LLaMA) were used only for generation, not for evaluation.
The paper only uses automatic metrics (accuracy) and does not mention any human evaluations

overall_notes: This paper focuses on Visual Question Answering as an NLG task. It uses LLaMA models for generating answers to visual questions evaluated using accuracy metric. The extraction was generally accurate but contained some models that were only referenced as baselines or mentioned in related work.
